final: WITH g AS (SELECT TrackId, COUNT(*) AS c FROM PlaylistTrack GROUP BY TrackId), s AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS tot FROM g WHERE c IS NOT NULL), p AS (SELECT g.TrackId, g.c, CAST(g.c AS REAL) / s.tot AS share FROM g JOIN s ON s.tot IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS av FROM p WHERE share IS NOT NULL), k AS (SELECT p.c, p.share, a.av FROM p JOIN a ON a.av IS NOT NULL WHERE p.share > a.av) SELECT AVG(c) AS avg_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - av) AS avg_share_minus_avg FROM k
